fields.description:
As a maintainer, I want every review-enforcing CI wrapper to fail-closed on a precondition/token failure so that a transient API blip, an expired/scope-stripped PAT, or a missing secret can never silently turn a required review gate green.

Plan refs: §2.5, §2.9 (Harden the R8 live drift guard), §2.10.1, A-5 prereq items 1-2. Foundation story — ship warn-safe (mode-gated), so no team impact until the enforce-flip story.

DONE DEFINITION:
- DD1: exit-78 handling is gated on mode in ALL THREE carriers — review-coverage-invariant.yml, dangling-references.yml, ruleset-invariants.yml (the 3rd carrier, CS-17, gates the already-required ruleset-design-invariants check). In warn: exit 78 -> exit 0 with ::warning (unchanged). In enforce: exit 78 -> BLOCK (non-zero). (SC2)
- DD2: test-ruleset-provisioner-roundtrip.sh `_live_round_trip` fail-closes under an enforce posture flag: a SKIP (no token / 403 / rulesets-not-found) returns FAIL in enforce, exit 0 only in warn. (SC2/SC3)
- DD3: the existing DSO_RULESETS_READ_TOKEN secret's scope (Administration:read / ruleset-structure read) and expiry are verified and recorded; CS-7a hygiene probe added (git credential fill + gh api user must NOT resolve to a bypass actor). (SC3)
- DD4: TDD coverage for each new fail-closed branch (RED before, GREEN after).

LIVE VERIFICATION + EXPERIMENTS:
- V0.3a-post-fix x3: scope-stripped token + DSO_*_MODE=enforce against each of the 3 carriers -> check RED (today it goes green via 78->0). In warn -> still green.
- R8-skip-fail: force the 403 condition under enforce -> roundtrip FAILS (vs today's PASSED-6 green-skip, V0.10).
- Confirm in a live CI run (warn mode) that all 3 carriers still pass normally (no false wedge introduced).

COURSE-CORRECTION TRIGGER: if making any wrapper fail-closed causes flakiness on normal PRs even in warn mode (e.g. R8 intermittently 403s with the configured PAT), STOP — the PAT/scope is unstable and must be fixed before any other enforce work depends on it.

Maps to SC2, SC3. No dependencies; can start immediately.
